title: fleet-guards: provider-API failure (USED=0 invalid-observation) silently disables waste alarm + burn marker
description: Codereview of 2ehk (correctness+security passes, kimi-k3). total_used() prints 0 on any OpenRouter credits-API failure (fleet-guards.sh:52); fleet_burn.py returns {"evaluated": false, "reason": "invalid-observation"} (fleet_burn.py:62-65) without touching the baseline. The shell extracts only evaluated, discards reason, and treats it as the normal mid-window case — no WARN, every cycle, forever if the outage is permanent (rotated key, endpoint change). In that state the waste alarm AND the $2000 burn marker (fleet-guards.sh:116, same USED) are dead with zero signal; the stall canary won't catch it because bd is local. Fix: WARN when reason == "invalid-observation" specifically (NOT on reason presence — baseline-established also carries a reason), e.g. extract reason like evaluated. Severity P2: same silent-death class (lh2z, $720/8h) the guards exist to prevent.
